headline: Copper Fund Rises 0.83% as Chile Mine Production Declines 8.4%
summary: Copper fund benchmark pricing increased 0.83% on Friday following a month-long slump, after official data showed Chilean mining output contracted 8.4% alongside weak demand figures from China.
why: Chile is the world's largest copper supplier; changes in its mining output strongly affect global industrial metal pricing.

impacts.name: Copper Futures
impacts.why: An 8.4% contraction in Chilean output tightened immediate physical supply outlooks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Declining mine production out of Chile helped industrial metals rebound from recent monthly lows.
